purpose: Three original minigame hardware backplates. No generated UI text or target markings.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original production background art for a 420 x 650 portrait pixel-art hacking game, Blacksite Relay.
Style: meticulous dark 2.5D pixel art, as a close-up of practical machinery inside a damp underground cyberpunk server vault. Hand-placed square pixel clusters, crisp stepped edges, richly textured worn metal, dark petrol teal shadows and localized amber maintenance light, restrained luminous cyan electronics. High-end detailed game art, not a photograph, not smooth 3D, not a UI mockup. Physical depth in the beveled hardware; the working plane is perfectly front-facing and rectangular so live controls can be drawn over it.
Format: single full-bleed portrait image, target aspect 420:650. The coordinate zones below refer to a logical 420 x 650 canvas; follow their normalized positions if output resolution differs. No border around the image. Reserve the required control zones with very dark nearly featureless matte surfaces; put intricate copper wires, scratched steel, screws, connectors, ribs and tiny unmarked indicator lenses around those zones. Sharp pixel clusters must survive reduction to 420 x 650. No lettering, words, digits, logos, watermark, pseudo-text, icons, arrows, gauge markings, drawn interface, characters, hands or animals. Every interactive element and all text will be overlaid separately in the game.
Shared composition: calm dark header zone y0-90, gently vignetted corners, restrained scene clutter, hardware aligned to the image axes, no camera tilt. Lighting remains believable and concentrated on metal edges, not on the blank interactive surface.
Primary request: exposed reactor calibration device, a substantial weathered industrial coupler unit embedded in the Blacksite workstation. Copper induction windings, a small contained amber core and paired ceramic insulators occupy x35-385, y110-250. This is the hero art band: luminous detailed coils with grounded occlusion, asymmetrical service cables around a symmetrical horizontal mechanism. No UI schematic and no empty line drawing.
Exact calm zones: a deep recessed unmarked charcoal-teal rectangular instrument well x25-395, y270-465, flat front-facing, uninterrupted. Live numerical readouts will occupy y280-325 and the scanner track will occupy y350-415, so draw absolutely no meters, ticks, lines or objects in this well. Frame the well with a thin realistic pixel-art steel bezel and copper fasteners outside its bounds. Keep y480-650 dark and visually quiet for help text and buttons, with faint cable texture limited to the extreme edges. Palette: oxidized copper, warm amber, petrol blue, blackened metal. The device is visually rich at the top and sides with a deliberately quiet working well.

Primary request: a battered heavy CRT injection terminal with a thick chipped dark teal metal casing, embedded beside the underground server rack. Main shell extends y105-485, physically substantial with layered square corner bevels, side vents, a few dusted unmarked indicator lenses, restrained teal phosphor glow reflected on its inner rim. This is a physical retro-futuristic machine, not a modern flat screen.
Exact calm zones: the CRT glass opening is a perfectly rectangular, front-facing and completely empty dark charcoal-teal surface x35-385, y170-430. No curved screen geometry, no text, no scan graphics, no crosshair, no bright reflections inside it. Live command, input and timer will be rendered on this glass by the game. A lower dark unmarked bezel from y438-485 accommodates error guidance. At y495-595 show a detailed chunky mechanical keyboard with blank unmarked keycaps and connected cables, rendered in the same restrained pixel-art perspective, but keep it decorative and away from the screen. Keep a calm dark payout strip y610-650. Header y0-90 remains dark. Palette: cold teal phosphor, dark gunmetal, muted amber service lamps, tiny copper wear. The machine must feel tangible and inhabited with minute abrasion and dust, without additional props obstructing the reserved rectangle.
